local_review.finding_body: The original test created child-loaded copies of the library and test providers with URLClassLoader.defineClass, then wrapped the entire library exercise in NativeImageSupport.runToleratingUnsupportedFeature. Because the unsupported operation came from the test harness rather than unavoidable library behavior, Native Image could accept the class-definition failure before executing the Snappy assertions, violating the native-execution and no-runtime-class-definition rules. The accompanying --add-opens native build flag was also unnecessary for the repaired public-API path.
local_review.finding_title: Native Image coverage was bypassed by test-created runtime class loading
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the custom class-loader and tolerated-failure path with a direct bundled-library extraction test that asserts a real Snappy compression round trip and the extracted JNI file, removed the unnecessary extraction setup and --add-opens flag, and accepted the metadata/statistics updates produced by Forge finalization.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the coordinate-scoped diff and the javac repair against the contribution and test contracts. The repaired test uses the 1.1.0.1 API, exercises bundled JNI extraction plus a Snappy compress/uncompress round trip on the JVM and Native Image, and retains 4/4 resource and overall dynamic-access coverage. The repair gate passes: overall 13/13 to 4/4 remains 100%, reflection 8/8 to 0/0 passes the no-call rule, and resources 5/5 to 4/4 remains 100%. The stable finalization pass completed all three native lanes, metadata validation, formatting, Checkstyle, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
